summary: Anthropic mechanistic interpretability researchers train a one-layer transformer and characterize 'interference weights' arising from weight superposition, showing helpfulness and effectiveness scores can identify and prune weights unrelated to the model's actual computation.

practices.reason: Introduces a method to score model weights by effectiveness and helpfulness to distinguish functional circuits from interference, relevant to interpretability evaluation but on a toy one-layer model not transferable to production systems.
practices.quote: A weight's effectiveness is the magnitude of its effect on the model's outputs. A weight's helpfulness is the magnitude and sign of its effect on the loss.
